name: oxide-warm-drum-glue
description: Warm tape glue + low-end weight on a drum bus via the UADx Oxide Tape Recorder. Repro path, 15 IPS (the warm/low-end setting), NAB (warmer top), NR on. input_level +7 drives ~1 dB of tape compression (crest 14.6 -> ~13.7) + odd-3rd body and a small LF lift (20-200 energy 0.918 -> 0.944). The simple/fast warm finisher; the lighter, lower-CPU cousin of the Ampex ATR-102 / Studer A800 drum-glue presets.
intended_for: a balanced stereo DRUM bus that wants quick warmth + gentle glue. Insert before the master; do NOT limit here.
plugin_build: uaudio_oxide_tape.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless; the 'UAD Oxide Tape.component' twin passes audio through unprocessed offline, do NOT use it).

target_signature.comment: measured dry -> processed on watercolors_drums_104bpm_8bar_a (peak-normed). dry centroid 3007, crest 14.63.

notes: input_level IS the drive (the primary color). +7 = ~1 dB glue; push to +10..+14 for audible saturation (crest -> ~12) but the odd-3rd stack climbs into grit past ~+16.
output_level is plugin make-up; here it offsets the +7 drive for ~unity so the A/B is loudness-matched (the harness still peak-trims to -1 dBFS).
For a brighter top swap emphasis_eq -> CCIR (centroid +~450); for more lo-fi color/frequency-shift go ips -> 7.5 IPS (leaner lows, more upper color).
NR (default on) only removes the modeled hiss/hum floor -> tonally transparent on a hot bus; it is NOT a tone control.
Verify: measure-loudness (crest), measure-spectrum (centroid/tilt/bands), render-ab loudness-matched. Pairs with [[warm-drum-bus]] / [[drum-bus-warm-tight-preference]].
